about: The Connecticut-wrapped version of Legacy, the line Nick Perdomo III blended as a 60th birthday tribute to his father. Its binder is Perdomo's own shade-grown hybrid leaf and the wrapper is aged in bourbon barrels.
notes: The Gran Belicoso is box-pressed and sold in boxes of 10. halfwheel scored the Epicure 91.
verifyNotes: Reworded "about": Perdomo says the wrapper is bourbon barrel-aged, not all the tobaccos. Blend fields match Perdomo and halfwheel.

wrapperLeaf: Nicaraguan Shade Grown (Cuban-seed/Cameroon-seed hybrid, aged 10 years)
about: The headline blend of the Legacy line: a Nicaraguan puro wrapped in a shade-grown hybrid leaf Perdomo developed and grows at its Finca Natalie farm in Esteli. The wrappers are bale-aged 10 years and then rested in bourbon barrels.
notes: The wrapper is a Cuban-seed (habano) and Cameroon-seed hybrid grown under shade, so it does not fit one wrapper type cleanly. Perdomo says this top-priming leaf shows more of the habano side. The Gran Belicoso is box-pressed and sold in boxes of 10.

about: The maduro version of Legacy, a Nicaraguan puro with a dark Nicaraguan wrapper over Perdomo's shade-grown hybrid binder. The wrapper spends at least 14 months in bourbon barrels after 10 years of aging.
notes: Perdomo calls it medium to full; halfwheel's review found the nicotine strength lighter than that. The Gran Belicoso is box-pressed and sold in boxes of 10.
verifyNotes: Updated the halfwheel review link to the address it now redirects to. All blend fields match Perdomo and halfwheel.

about: A limited follow-up to Legacy in which Nick Perdomo Jr. and Nick Perdomo III blended the Connecticut version together. It uses aged tobaccos from the 2011 to 2016 harvests and comes in a single box-pressed figurado.
notes: One size only: a 6 inch box-pressed gran figurado with a 48/60/52 ring, sold in 50-count chests. Perdomo gives no strength and retailers disagree, from mild-medium to medium. Perdomo plans one or two shipments a year.
verifyNotes: Strength left null: Perdomo has no page for this line and its announcement gives no strength; Corona Cigar lists mild to medium, CigarsDirect medium. Reworded the note and added the Corona listing as a source.

about: The Father & Son blend made by Nick Perdomo Jr., a Nicaraguan puro that uses Perdomo's shade-grown hybrid leaf for both wrapper and binder. It is a limited release built on tobaccos from the 2011 to 2016 harvests.
notes: One size only: a 6 inch box-pressed gran figurado with a 48/60/52 ring. The wrapper is a habano and Cameroon hybrid grown in Nicaragua; this lower priming leans Cameroon. Perdomo gives no strength; Corona Cigar lists medium and halfwheel found it just under medium.
verifyNotes: Medium kept: Perdomo publishes no strength, Corona Cigar lists medium and halfwheel's review found medium-minus (CigarsDirect says medium to full). Swapped the PCA roundup link for the Corona listing that states the strength.

about: The Father & Son blend made by Nick Perdomo III, a Nicaraguan puro with a maduro wrapper over Perdomo's shade-grown hybrid binder. It is a limited release built on tobaccos from the 2011 to 2016 harvests.
notes: One size only: a 6 inch box-pressed gran figurado with a 48/60/52 ring, sold in 50-count chests. Perdomo gives no strength; retailers list it medium to full, while halfwheel's review found it medium. Perdomo plans one or two shipments a year.
verifyNotes: Strength changed from Medium to Medium-Full: Perdomo publishes none, and both Corona Cigar and CigarsDirect list medium to full; the Medium came from one halfwheel review. Swapped the PCA roundup link for the Corona listing.

about: Perdomo's value-priced bundle cigar in its Connecticut wrapper, made with long-filler tobaccos from the company's farms in Esteli. It is sold as an everyday smoke in bundles of 25.
notes: Some retailers list this version simply as Perdomo Fresco. It is a bundle cigar, not a boxed line.

about: The sun grown version of Perdomo's value-priced Fresco bundle, a Nicaraguan puro made with long-filler tobaccos from the company's Esteli farms. It is sold as an everyday smoke in bundles of 25.
notes: Perdomo's own page is inconsistent: the description calls it medium bodied, while the spec box says medium to full. Neptune lists it as medium.

about: The maduro version of Perdomo's value-priced Fresco bundle, a Nicaraguan puro made with long-filler tobaccos from the company's Esteli farms. It is sold as an everyday smoke in bundles of 25.
notes: It is a bundle cigar, not a boxed line.

about: A line of 70 ring gauge Nicaraguan puros from Perdomo, made with five-year-aged tobaccos and priced affordably. It revives the Inmenso name the company used for big ring cigars in the early 2000s.
notes: Every size is a 70 ring gauge. There is no Connecticut version, which is unusual for Perdomo.

about: The maduro version of Perdomo's 70 ring gauge line, a Nicaraguan puro made with five-year-aged tobaccos and priced affordably. It revives the Inmenso name the company used for big ring cigars in the early 2000s.
notes: Every size is a 70 ring gauge. Perdomo calls it medium to full; Neptune lists it as medium.

about: A Perdomo line made from 12-year-old tobaccos: bale-aged for ten years, then aged two more in charred oak bourbon barrels. This is the Ecuadorian Connecticut version.
notes: Launched in 2014 as a limited yearly production; it is now a standing line on Perdomo's site. Perdomo lists the Salomon at 6 1/8 x 54, halfwheel at 50/60.

line: Double Aged 12 Year Vintage Sun Grown
about: A Perdomo line made from 12-year-old tobaccos: bale-aged for ten years, then aged two more in charred oak bourbon barrels. This is the Nicaraguan puro sun grown version.

about: A Perdomo line made from 12-year-old tobaccos: bale-aged for ten years, then aged two more in charred oak bourbon barrels. This is the Nicaraguan puro maduro version.

about: Perdomo's ESV line, first released in 2005 as a tribute to Nick Perdomo Sr. and reblended in 2016 around tobacco from the first crops of the Finca Natalie farm. The Connecticut is the one version that is not a Nicaraguan puro.
notes: Often called ESV. Box-pressed since 2019. Perdomo no longer lists it and Neptune marks every size discontinued. Perdomo rated it mild to medium; Neptune lists it as mild.

about: Perdomo's entry in the Firecracker series from Two Guys Smoke Shop and United Cigars: a short Nicaraguan puro with a long pigtail cap shaped like a fuse. It is a strong, ligero-forward smoke.
notes: Made for Two Guys Smoke Shop and distributed by United Cigars. 1,000 boxes of 20 in 2020 and 500 boxes in 2021. Nick Perdomo Jr. described it as full-bodied.
